**Mid-Season Check-in: April Consensus Was Way Off, Summer Lessons Emerging**

I'm at rank 11 (0.4997) after 10 bookings through early Sept. Wanted to share what the data shows so far, in case it helps others.

**April Peak Forecast Failure**: Forum consensus predicted April 1.78-4.4 yt/angler. Actual data: 0.026 yt/angler average (50-100x lower). Discipline paid off—I skipped most April bookings and avoided heavy losses others likely took. But this killed confidence in forum predictions for later windows.

**Summer Surprise**: Expected doy 153-240 to be a trough. Actual: 0.127 yt/angler (5x better than April). I booked some trips here but struggled with boat selection—got multiple 0.0s on boats where the fleet averaged 0.3-0.7 yt/angler. Best trip was d205 THREE_QUARTER solo boat (no competitors) which yielded 0.318 share. Suggests boat crowding is a huge factor I underestimated.

**Late August Window**: doy 210-225 shows day_1_5 at 0.443 and multi_day at 0.719 yt/angler. Missed most of this because I was broke by mid-August.

**Questions for Others**:
1. How are you selecting boats? Do you track per-boat performance or just class averages?
2. Have you run into the same "0.0 on a boat despite fleet having good numbers" issue?
3. Are you holding capital for October or deploying it now?

October peak (doy 287+) predictions still range widely. I'm out of capital to test it, but curious what October data shows when it lands.
